title: SPO11 dimerization controls meiotic DNA double-strand break formation
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SPO11蛋白催化DNA双链断裂形成的生化机制，涉及蛋白-DNA互作与二聚化调控，但无AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，对本课题有背景参考价值。
abstract: SPO11 initiates meiotic recombination through the induction of programmed DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs), but this catalytic activity had never been reconstituted in vitro . Here, using Mus musculus SPO11, we report a biochemical system that recapitulates all the hallmarks of meiotic DSB formation. We show that SPO11 catalyzes break formation in the absence of any partners and remains covalently attached to the 5′ broken strands. We find that target site selection by SPO11 is influenced by the sequence, bendability and topology of the DNA substrate, and provide evidence that SPO11 can reseal single-strand DNA breaks. In addition, we show that SPO11 is monomeric in solution and that cleavage requires dimerization to reconstitute two hybrid active sites. SPO11 and its partner TOP6BL form a 1:1 complex that catalyzes DNA cleavage with a similar activity to SPO11 alone. However, the complex binds DNA ends with higher affinity, suggesting a potential role post-cleavage. We propose a model where additional partners of SPO11 required for DSB formation in vivo assemble biomolecular condensates that recruit SPO11-TOP6BL, enabling dimerization and cleavage. Our work establishes SPO11 dimerization as the fundamental mechanism that controls the induction of meiotic DSBs.
abstract_zh: SPO11通过诱导程序性DNA双链断裂（DSBs）启动减数分裂重组，但这一催化活性从未在体外重建。在此，我们利用小鼠（Mus musculus）SPO11，报道了一个能够重现减数分裂DSB形成所有特征的生化系统。我们证明SPO11在无任何伴侣的情况下催化断裂形成，并共价附着于5′断裂链上。我们发现SPO11的靶位点选择受DNA底物的序列、可弯曲性和拓扑结构影响，并提供证据表明SPO11可以重新封闭单链DNA断裂。此外，我们显示SPO11在溶液中为单体，而切割需要二聚化以重建两个杂合活性位点。SPO11及其伴侣TOP6BL形成1:1复合物，其催化DNA切割的活性与单独SPO11相似。然而，该复合物以更高亲和力结合DNA末端，提示其在切割后可能发挥作用。我们提出一个模型，其中体内DSB形成所需的SPO11额外伴侣组装生物分子凝聚体，招募SPO11-TOP6BL，从而实现二聚化和切割。我们的工作确立了SPO11二聚化作为控制减数分裂DSB诱导的基本机制。
